fieldValues.title: clerk claim and clerk care report different care modes for the same issue
fieldValues.summary: For srs-context#112, clerk claim printed 'Care mode: build, by rule 1' while clerk care, run a moment later, printed 'Mode: Careful, by rule 4: a clear plan on thin theory is careful'. The duties differ (Careful requires gate:owner-merge and an assumptions block), so a builder following claim's line would open the PR with the wrong gate.
evidence: clerk claim srs-context#112 and clerk care srs-context#112, 2026-10-30 ~10:20 UTC, from the same srs-programme checkout (origin/master)
The same mismatch on srs-context#113 (claim: build; care: Careful)
fieldValues.body:
- The driver followed the stricter mode (care) and labelled PR #120 gate:owner-merge.
- Likely cause: claim grades from a different input set than care (claim ran before the blocked label was removed, or reads the grounding without the theory facts).
